ops.entry: WHEN grading a new injection or traversal path DO verify the least-privileged input editor’s existing capabilities in the same execution context before rating severity. Equal or greater capability under the same controls makes it hardening; a different identity, target, or bypassed approval can still cross a boundary.
ops.why: The review rated a new write sink before comparing the inventory editor’s rights with the executable code already run by the same suite. This replaces the overbroad assumption that controlling a value implies holding the privilege it grants.

originals.original: WHEN grading a possible finding DO name the threat model before severity: an actor who already controls a value already holds the privilege it grants (no escalation, not a finding); a control reachable only from a higher-trust step than the threat actor is defense-in-depth, not a gap.
